params.text:
Deck A and Deck B: ten looks each, a tenth of the slider apart -
  1 Clean  2 Neon Edges  3 Mosaic  4 Thermal  5 Halftone
  6 Chroma Split  7 Melt  8 Motion Trails  9 Imprint  10 Follow Spot
(slider 0, 26, 51, 77, 102, 128, 153, 179, 204, 230). A - B crossfades; Auto mix on the bar swings it to the other deck every four beats; Shuffle looks gives each deck a random look as the mix leaves it, so it comes back as something new - both on, it runs a show by itself. Every look is a sub-graph: Tab enters one.
Where each pixel looks on the video: its own place, or (kaleidoscope) a copy turned by spin and folded into a mirror - every look reads the frame through these u and v.

What moves: this frame's brightness against a running average of the last few. motion is 1 where something moved just now; trail follows it and fades (hold: how slowly); centre u / v is the middle of what moves, gliding, and presence how much moves at all. It keeps its memory in fields 0 to 3 - use one per graph.
The video as it is - amount adds colour and punch.
Only the outlines, in the palette's colours, the colours drifting with t - amount is how bright the edges come out.
Big blocks of the picture - the more amount, the bigger.
A heat camera: brightness as black, violet, red, yellow, white - amount opens it up, so dimmer things run hot.
A newspaper photo: a dot per cell, as big as the picture is bright there, in its colour - amount makes the cells bigger and fewer.
Red, green and blue pulled apart, the way a cheap lens or a glitch does - amount is how far, and they breathe with t.

The picture runs down like wax: every pixel takes the brighter of the video and what was just above it last frame, a little dimmer - amount is how fast it drips. It reads the LEDs' last frame, so the other deck's look melts with it while they mix.

Tracers: whatever moves leaves a glowing trail behind it, newest end bright, running through the palette as it fades - the video under it dims with amount so the trails stand out. trail comes from VS Motion.

Afterimages: what moves is stamped in its own colours and stays, fading slowly, over a faint copy of the video - a dancer leaves copies of themselves. amount is how long they stay. motion comes from VS Motion.

A spotlight that follows whatever moves: the picture lit in a circle round the middle of the motion, the rest in shadow, with a lock-on ring and cross-hairs while it has something to follow. amount is the spot's size. centre u / v and presence come from VS Motion.
One of ten looks by which, 0..1: each a tenth of the range (0 the first, 1 the last). A deck: wire a slider to which, a look to each number.
A into B as crossfade goes 0 to 1, eased at the ends.
